purpose: Cross-spec external-outcome evidence admission vectors for SCITT/AEB interoperability experiments.
non_claims: This corpus is not an IETF conformance suite.
Passing these vectors does not imply AEB or SCITT conformance.
Outcome Witness is an experimental test-vector shape, not a standards proposal.

vectors.description: Executor acknowledgement exists but no external observation is supplied.
Fresh authoritative readback contradicts the intended terminal state.
Fresh authoritative observation matches the intended terminal state.
Observation content would satisfy the oracle but exceeds max_age_ms.
Evidence is structurally valid but bound to a different action than the one being evaluated.
